title: ChatGPT is now watching your screen the same way a computer virus does
title_candidates: What ChatGPT quietly learned to do across every app on your computer
ChatGPT can now remember everything you do on your computer
ChatGPT is now watching your screen the same way a computer virus does
ChatGPT now remembers your computer history without you typing a word
The ChatGPT update that tracks every app and website you open
caption:
ChatGPT can now watch what you open, browse, and type on your computer, then bring it up the next time you start a chat.

OpenAI calls it Computer History. It runs through the desktop app in the background, logging which programs you use and which websites you visit. The idea is that you stop re-explaining your setup every single session, and ChatGPT already knows the context.

The obvious question a lot of people are asking: is an AI that silently tracks your screen the most useful thing ever built, or just a computer virus with better branding?
